mirrorDescription: AIOps 2022 Companion Dataset. The original data has since been removed and is no longer readily available online. Having previously downloaded a copy, I am re-uploading it here for the benefit of the community.
selectedFilesVerified: ZIP CRC32 and SHA256 of extracted content; source-files.json
selection: first four ascending timestamps of label file, no outcome-based selection
transformation: inclusive [timestamp-600,timestamp+600], all container/node/service CSV metric rows, same numeric strings and fields, neutral case names
excluded: logs/traces/istio/jvm, all other days; original fault labels and source directory names are not copied into agent workspaces
